pinout.notes: Bidirectional ESD array for USB D+/D-. Pinout per datasheet; I/O1/I/O2 are the protected lines, GND/VBUS as marked.

verification_notes: VRRM, VBR, VC, package verified. Low-capacitance (~3 pF) ESD array specifically for USB2.
replacement_notes: ESD diode replacement MUST match VRRM (>= rail), VC (<= IC abs max), capacitance (<= the interface spec — USB2 needs <5pF), and the channel count. A generic TVS will load USB2 too heavily.
